tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search a PersonAIzer persona's knowledge base (site pages, documents, and products) for content relevant to a query. Requires the caller's PersonAIzer secret API key in the X-Api-Key header.

tools.name: create_persona
tools.description: Start building a new PersonAIzer persona from a website URL — scrapes the site, synthesizes an identity, generates an avatar, and (by default) harvests the site's content into the persona's knowledge base. Asynchronous (~1 minute) — returns a job_id and persona_id; poll check_persona_status. Require

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message to a PersonAIzer persona and get its reply, including any knowledge-base cards it surfaces. Requires the persona's own secret API key (persona_id is then implied), or an account-level API key plus persona_id.

tools.name: upload_knowledge_docs
tools.description: Upsert up to 100 structured knowledge documents (products, FAQs, etc.) into a persona's knowledge base. Requires the persona's own secret API key — not an account-level key.

tools.name: check_persona_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a persona build started by create_persona. Requires an account-level API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chat · Private data: search_knowledge, create_persona, chat, upload_knowledge_docs, check_persona_status · Public sink: chat, upload_knowledge_docs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chat · Private data: search_knowledge, create_persona, chat, upload_knowledge_docs, check_persona_status · Public sink: chat, upload_knowledge_docs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
